product.name: Quadrant AI Platform
product.description: A platform designed to automate and scale care management, remote monitoring, and behavioral health by integrating with existing EHR systems.

product.name: Quadrant AI Assistants
product.description: AI assistants that help scale care teams by automating administrative and clinical tasks.

product.name: Quadrant Scribe
product.description: A tool that transcribes patient conversations and extracts actionable insights, including appointment requests and referrals.

product.name: Scheduling and Referrals
product.description: A service that allows patients to schedule, reschedule, and cancel appointments, and receive reminders via SMS.

product.name: Medication Refills
product.description: A service that streamlines medication management without the need for phone calls or emails.

product.name: Patient Navigation and Q&A
product.description: A service that answers patient questions using information from various sources like the website and EHR.
